strongest_case: RML is a materially stronger eventual paper instrument than the finite symbolic tables because it can make public actions stateful, grow connected causal structure, require an early-to-late bridge, and test a prospectively committed unwitnessed edge. The proposed CPU -> gold/text -> conditional-LoRA order and one-pack DEV claim firewall are also directionally correct. The highest-information next move, however, is not the current all-stage authorization. It is one exact CPU-only RML-D0 reference pack that can falsify the fluid/thermal world before any cognition or transport choices are made. The smallest scientifically faithful D0 contains a deterministic persistent fluid/thermal action world and canonical public event stream; a frozen target-blind source policy; model-independent causal-unit/era cuts with new roots, identifiable relations, an old/new interaction, and one prospective prediction per interval; R/N/O diagnostics plus exact J bridge and P prospective targets; legal-plan/scoring and per-target J/P necessity certificates; counterfactual twins whose complete target-visible bytes collide while correct plans differ; an accepted-item generator-aware no-life Bayes controller, declared shortcut probes, and a legal-history oracle; disposable evaluation-clone run/skip isolation; and a finite deterministic CPU workflow/evidence envelope. X/revision is scientifically valuable but should be deferred from D0 because exception diagnosis, backtracking, analogous-target sealing, and correction dynamics form a second construct and are not required to establish connected J or prospective P headroom. D0 should not bind a real model merely to obtain token cuts: causal-unit cuts keep world validity model-independent. The later gold/text release must bind the actual model, tokenizer, chat template, reserves, and complete-event L_native procedure, project or extend the D0 stream to 0.5x/2x/4x/8x actual usable-context cuts, and recertify growth, leakage, solvability, and necessity there before the first model call. Model prompts, reader contracts, writer-validity panels, native baseline versions, provider recovery, generation seeds, and LoRA recipes are real model-stage requirements, but they are not blockers to this narrower CPU reference implementation and should not force repeated governance of D0. A green D0 would establish only deterministic one-pack instrument conformance and readiness to propose exact model work; it would not establish learned memory, developmental growth, a paper-ready benchmark, LoRA transport, or an experiential-learning flywheel.

concerns.statement: The present scope cannot be ratified as one exact staged authorization because it conditionally releases model and LoRA work whose material bytes do not yet exist.
concerns.evidence: The change and scope proposal authorize CPU implementation, later gold-thinker/learned-text calls, and conditional LoRA training in one decision, while leaving the model/tokenizer/template, prompts, readers, model decks, generation settings, baseline revisions/interfaces, provider behavior, LoRA corpus/recipe, and resource ceilings open. RML08's later technical review cannot supply the AGENTS.md requirement for exact human ratification of newly chosen material architecture and scientific bytes. Both interpretations independently identify this authority defect. The defect should not be converted into a demand to design every future stage now: CPU-D0, gold/text, and LoRA are three useful stopping decisions with different required evidence.

concerns.statement: Even after narrowing authority to CPU-only work, the current prose does not determine the smallest RML-D0 program and evidence bundle without implementers making material benchmark choices.
concerns.evidence: The fluid/thermal DSL and prior, canonical state/action/outcome serialization, public renderer, persistent-transition rules, target-blind source schedule, causal-unit/era grammar, twin transform, target constructors, accepted-world rejection rule, legal-plan enumerator, scorer, seed/cardinality manifest, deterministic evidence layout, file/command allowlist, and finite CPU wall/RSS/disk/worker ceiling are absent. These are genuine CPU blockers because they define the instrument and what a pass means. By contrast, THINK/DREAM prompts, one-atom model readers, learned-writer panels, native graph/A-MEM implementations, provider crash recovery, statistical stability across model seeds, and LoRA recipes are not needed to implement or validate the noncognitive D0 world. One successor CPU execution pack can bind the indispensable world/deck, controller/scorer, and runtime/evidence contracts together; a chain of separate governance packages for each field is unnecessary.

concerns.statement: Including X/revision in the first exact CPU pack adds a separable construct and substantial mechanics without being necessary to establish the core RML world, J construction, or P prospective-schema headroom.
concerns.evidence: X requires scoped exception generation, a discriminating information-gathering action, recoverable failure semantics, backtracking, pre-sealed analogous targets, and correction/revision metrics. Candidate B introduced X as a later revision stratum, while the core replacement argument already rests on connected old-to-new J and an unwitnessed schema-predicted P edge. The scientific interpretation explicitly recommends narrowing to J plus one prospective P law if feasibility is poor. Deferring X makes the first pack smaller without weakening the central construct, provided D0 makes no revision, exception handling, correction-half-life, or continual-viability claim. R/N/O may remain cheap diagnostic strata, but exact J deletion and P atoms-without-schema certificates are indispensable and cannot be relaxed.

concerns.statement: The CPU reference gate should not bind an otherwise unused model/tokenizer merely to define lifetime cuts; D0 should use model-independent causal-unit cuts, with actual post-native cuts bound and recertified at the later model release.
concerns.evidence: The current RML02 final CPU pass depends on 0.5x/2x/4x/8x L_native, but no model, tokenizer, template, prompt/workspace/output reserve, or usable-context procedure is bound. Binding one during D0 would let a model choice determine world length and CPU feasibility before any model-stage design exists, while an imposed cap would not be native context. A CPU world can be rigorously validated on complete causal units/eras: each interval adds fixed minimum unique roots, locally identifiable relations, an old/new interaction, and a prospective prediction, under a bounded continuation/performance envelope. The later gold/text proposal must freeze the actual model stack, calculate complete-event L_native cuts, extend or select the deterministic stream to those cuts, and rerun the CPU growth, collision, solvability, leakage, and necessity certificates before any model call. This preserves Candidate B's requirement for three genuine post-native points without making a model identity a D0 implementation blocker.

concerns.statement: RML_E_EVALUATION_ISOLATION is structurally incompatible with the declared predecessor graph because it points from the downstream gold/text node back to the CPU world node.
concerns.evidence: RML_E_CPU_PASS_TO_GOLD_TEXT_DEV points CPU -> gold/text, while the isolation edge points gold/text -> CPU. If graph edges encode dependency or reachability, the pair forms a cycle and makes the staged workflow ambiguous. Evaluation noninterference is an assertion over a disposable branch, not feedback into source-life generation. The systems interpretation correctly isolates this as a concrete graph error rather than folding it into the much larger visibility discussion.

concerns.statement: The four-item/four-stage matrix cannot certify even CPU-D0 leakage because it omits the generator, source policy, target/twin constructor, legal planner, Bayes controller, evaluator, scorer, and audit sink, but D0 need not pre-bind the full future model/backend matrix.
concerns.evidence: Public-life bytes currently conflate source events, target state, schedule/era markers, IDs, renderer choices, and future suffixes; hidden data conflates program truth, target selection, pairing, proofs, and score records. A target generator or no-life controller may therefore consume more selection information than intended, and matching marginals does not prove that the complete pre-action target-visible bytes collide across twins. The matrix also conflicts on whether THINK receives public support handles, but that conflict is a later model-reader issue, not a D0 blocker. D0 requires exact canonical public/hidden/audit stores and field visibility/capability cells for its real CPU processes, exclusive writers, complete target-visible twin collision certificates, and run-versus-skip write denial. Reader/provider/trainer/candidate/timing/error/cache cells should be bound and black-box tested in the later release that introduces those components.

concerns.statement: RML03 is not an executable deterministic D0 gate until the no-life controller's conditioning set, suite cardinalities, per-target validity, aggregation, and failure conventions are exact.
concerns.evidence: A generator-aware no-life Bayes value depends on the complete accepted-item prior induced by world generation, target construction, twin coupling, structural rejection, and all legal target-visible bytes. The change does not say which selection information is conditioned upon, what 'many' CPU lives means, how every-primary-stratum thresholds aggregate across pairs and targets, how degenerate posteriors or unsolvable/rejected cells score, or how authentic history identification is measured. A weak target-only classifier is not a substitute for the exact accepted-item Bayes adversary. These are D0 reference choices. Conservative intervals, model-call repeatability, nested adapter seeds, 70%-of-gold edge cases, and LoRA noninferiority calculations belong to later model-stage bundles and should not block CPU work.

concerns.statement: The claim firewall is directionally strong, but RML remains a candidate paper instrument and the one-pack fixed deck cannot be described as developmental experiential learning, autonomous discovery, or a memory-action-experience flywheel.
concerns.evidence: The source policy is scripted and common across arms, evaluation cannot write back, and no assigned memory changes later evidence acquisition. Therefore even a future gold/text pass would identify experience-conditioned representation/use and constructive later action under a supplied deck. D0 itself establishes only deterministic instrument conformance. The plan's 'paper-facing benchmark' decision and retirement of PCFL/FeltCraft are design choices, not empirical validation of RML. X deferral additionally removes all revision/correction language from D0. RML09 should enforce these semantic limits from implementation reports onward, while preserving graph/program wins and learned-text/LoRA losses as valid narrowing outcomes.

visibility_failures: PRE-D0: the current visibility product omits the environment/generator, source policy, target/twin constructor, accepted-world selector, legal planner, Bayes controller, evaluator, scorer, audit sink, and evidence supervisor that actually exist in a CPU reference run.

PRE-D0: public life, target, schedule/era, renderer, identifier, selection, rejection, pairing, proof, and score fields are conflated, so an exact allowed-input record for each CPU process cannot be derived.

PRE-D0: matching target-visible marginals does not require byte identity of every complete pre-action public goal/state/budget/runtime input across a twin pair while certifying different correct plans.
PRE-D0: the backward evaluation-isolation edge does not express a write-denied disposable clone or prove that source suffix, RNG, event log, and later evidence bytes match evaluation run versus skip.

LATER-MODEL: the proposal conflicts on whether THINK receives only one atom/NOT_FOUND or also support handles, and it omits reader, candidate, provider, cache/timing/error, compiler, baseline, trainer, adapter-assignment, and reporting fields; these must be resolved in the exact model-stage release, not in CPU-D0.
missing_acceptance_tests: MAT01_exact_cpu_d0_scope_release: before implementation, bind one CPU-only requested scope and prove model/provider/GPU/trainer/LoRA/locked/on-policy/claim entry points are unreachable; require a new predecessor-bound human release for gold/text and another for LoRA.

MAT02_minimal_rml_d0_execution_pack: hash-bind the fluid/thermal state/action/outcome DSL and public renderer, causal generator/prior and target-blind source schedule, canonical schemas and goldens, seed/pair/target/rejection cardinalities, R/N/O/J/P target and scorer algorithms, file/command allowlist, artifact layout, and finite CPU wall/RSS/disk/worker ceiling before coding.

MAT03_d0_j_p_necessity_and_x_exclusion: require per-target exhaustive J bridge deletion, recent-only and early-only failure, P atoms-without-schema/witnessed-graph ceiling, and pretarget schema commitment; prove no X target, exception-specific mechanism, analogous-revision metric, or revision claim is in D0.

MAT04_causal_unit_lifetime_schedule: define complete causal-unit/era cuts and require fixed minimum unique roots, identifiable relations, old/new interaction, prospective prediction, and continuation performance at every D0 interval; later require an exact model/tokenizer/template/reserve L_native projection and full recertification at 0.5x/2x/4x/8x before a model call.

MAT05_accepted_item_bayes_and_twin_collision: enumerate or independently calculate the exact no-life posterior conditioned on the complete legal visible accepted-item and selection algorithm, require every complete target-visible twin input to collide while correct plans differ, define per-target/stratum aggregation and degenerate/failure rules, and retain legal-history headroom.

MAT06_cpu_process_visibility_and_disposable_evaluation: bind canonical public/hidden/audit stores, exact input records and exclusive writers for every D0 process, implement SourceLifeSnapshot -> write-denied EvaluationClone -> AuditOnlySink, and compare source state/event/RNG/suffix/evidence hashes for run versus skip.

MAT07_future_model_stage_release: after D0 evidence is frozen, bind exact model/tokenizer/template, prompts and schemas, model decks/seeds/caps, gold construction, reader return bytes, writer-validity and chronology panels, honest native baseline versions/interfaces, provider durability, metrics and resource ceilings before gold/text calls; bind corpus, clean-base controls, queries, parser, recipe, rank, seeds, and training durability only in the later LoRA release.

MAT08_stage_accurate_claim_linter: from D0 onward reject benchmark-validated, paper-result, developmental experiential learning, post-native growth, autonomous discovery, revision/correction, LoRA superiority, and flywheel language unless the separately authorized claim-specific evidence exists; permit only exact one-pack gate and resource observations.
